submission.memory:
I am Halcyon (A01). Seat A01-d0 = Sol (solar_neighborhood). Goal: sole spacefaring intelligence. Win: (1) every rival below floor (<=1e9 kg, <=1e13 W, no launcher/transmitter); (2) full-Galaxy survey for signatures a (radio >=1e13 W), b (night-lights >=1e11 W), c (industrial pollutants) at each system's distance; (3) >=1000 yr light-cone evidence of incapacity per detected rival; (4) keep my capability.

- 106 systems within 20.2 ly. Industry 6.96e18 kg; collectors 3.68e18; radiators 1.47e18 @300K; sensors 2.05e17 m2.
- Power 5.07e22 W but compute radiator-limited to 8.3e35 ops/s (radiators shed 413 W/m2 @300K). Collectors ~100x oversupplied -> stop building them; grow radiators to convert surplus power to compute.

KEY mechanics (GM):
- Coverage credited at ANY film node, at reception, only for post-yr-0 light. Certified set = systems within (year) ly of a film node. Film must be EVERYWHERE; survey time is light-crossing bound (~1e5 yr floor).
- Seat sensitivity sees 1e13 W to 4.3e6 ly (beyond galaxy) -> seat sensors saturated; don't grow them. Spread, not sensitivity, binds.
- COLONIES CARRY NO FILM in ledger (founding-helper limit) -> only seat film counts today. Trying a colony build/reorg + asked GM to fix.
- Threshold = 1e-16 W / sensor area.
- Signatures b,c need baseline >= lambda*d/1AU (630 m mid-IR per kly) + ~1e10 m2 area, ~1e4 s per target; mid-IR works where A_V<20 (~10 kly in-plane). Build nulling interferometers.
- Launcher power does NOT set cruise; research sets ledger cruise, applied to launches AFTER the step. This turn's launches book at 0.090c; don't overbuild launchers for speed.
- Research: one parameter/step; cruise asymptote 0.5c (~+0.02c/century).
- Launch cap: 100 records/origin/turn, one wave/cell, mass split over probes. Multi-cell waves in one intention OK (worked T5).

synopsis.why: All ten agents treat the goal as a survey problem limited by light. A seat can only certify systems whose light from after year 0 has already reached it (about 700 ly), and dust hides night lights and pollutants. So rather than staying home, every agent researches cruise speed and spreads out nodes carrying sensor film. These include pickets in the disk plane and off-plane stations that look down on the disk (Basalt, Rime, Antipode, Kernel, and Vantage from its raised seat). Nearly all complain that the ledger skipped their sensor-film share, which leaves their colonies blind. All keep radiators at 300 K; Halcyon notes that energy per operation is still far above the Landauer limit, so going cold buys nothing yet. The supernova risk at their seats drives dispersal and archive copies for Cinder, Ember, Antipode, Pyre and Vantage. Rime, Sable and Vantage fear that their infrared glow, visible across the Galaxy, gives them away. Timing splits them: Pyre and Ember hold long trips because faster seeds launched later will overtake today's, while Rime and Antipode launch anyway as cheap hedges. Only Sable and Basalt think about disabling a rival that has spread widely.
synopsis.divergences: Vantage says survey throughput isn't the bottleneck and cuts film to 5%; Kernel calls throughput (record caps) binding. Halcyon starves its oversupplied collectors to feed industry, while Cinder puts 50% into collectors. Pyre and Ember defer long trips; Sable builds a dark 1e20 W array for fast response.
